answers.core: It is a UI/UX experience that feels frustrating and difficult to interact with. Even if zoom was added to the AnimationNodeStateMachine, it would force people to zoom in to re-arrange nodes, and then zoom back out to see the graph. Easier to move the rename to a right click menu option and allow the full space of the node to easily act as a click surface for moving.

title: Add a context menu option to rename animation nodes in the AnimationNodeStateMachine editor
